# ParallelLingvo

> ParallelLingvo is a multilingual vocabulary learning application built around one idea: a single word — with all its translations, example sentences and pronunciation — lives in one card instead of being duplicated across separate bilingual decks. Learners can select multiple languages at once and progress in all of them from a single lesson.

Canonical public website: https://parallellingvo.app/
Learning application: https://app.parallellingvo.app/
Source repository: https://github.com/ViktorIovenko/Learn_English_and_Dutch

## Website localization

The public marketing site is available in two languages:

- English (EN): https://parallellingvo.app/
- Русский / Russian (RU): https://parallellingvo.app/ru/

The learning application itself supports a 48-language catalog (see below); the marketing site's own language is a separate, smaller set.

## What ParallelLingvo does

- One vocabulary concept connects to every language a learner is studying, instead of one deck per language pair.
- AI-built lessons: give it a word, a list, or a topic, and it generates translations, example sentences and a ready lesson.
- Spelling practice: learners type each word out letter by letter rather than just recognising it, with pronunciation audio per language.
- Family accounts: a parent can see a child's real progress, set a priority lesson, and hand over new words that land directly in the child's queue.
- Four ways to add words: paste your own list, let AI generate a deck from a topic and level, connect another AI tool via an MCP connector, or import a deck shared by another user.
- Difficult-word marking: flagged words can be trained separately from the rest of the deck.

## Languages

48 languages at launch: the major European languages plus Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian and Vietnamese. More can be added without redesigning the underlying storage.

## Platforms

- Telegram Mini App: https://app.parallellingvo.app/
- Web app (mobile-first): https://app.parallellingvo.app/
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.parallellingvo
- iOS: planned, not yet available.

## Pricing

- Free (with ads): 48 languages, unlimited lessons, audio and difficult-word review; no AI-built lessons.
- €3/month (no ads): everything in Free, ad-free.
- €6/month (best value): everything in the €3 plan, plus AI-built lessons and AI-generated translations and example sentences.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Which languages are supported?
A: 48 at launch — the major European languages plus Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian and Vietnamese. More can be added without redesigning storage.

Q: Can I really learn more than three languages at once?
A: Yes. Translations stay attached to the same concept, so a session in one lesson moves every selected language forward.

Q: How is it different from a flashcard app?
A: Flashcards are bilingual by design — one deck per pair. Here the structure itself is multilingual, and you type the word out letter by letter instead of just recognising it.

Q: Does it work on mobile?
A: Yes — a mobile-first web app, an Android app, and a Telegram mini app. Native iOS is planned.
